Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework

Interface IWorlds

public interface IWorlds
Worlds facet of the framework: create worlds from defaults, specs, or provisioned templates, or configure one through a builder.

Obtained from ILightkeeperFramework.worlds().

    • fromTemplate

      WorldHandle fromTemplate(String templateName)
      Loads a world from a pre-provisioned template folder.

      Templates are world folders provisioned into the server directory by the Maven plugin's <worlds> configuration (typically with loadOnStartup=false). The name is validated against the runtime manifest's provisioned-template list before touching the server: a typo fails loudly instead of silently creating a fresh world.

      A provisioned world that is already loaded (e.g. one with loadOnStartup=true) is returned as-is rather than reloaded.

      Parameters:
      templateName - The provisioned world folder's name.
      Returns:
      A handle for the loaded world.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If no template with that name was provisioned; the message lists the available templates.
